name: George A. Simons
locations: North West Township, Williams County, Ohio
sources: Ancestry.com, 1850 United States Federal Census (Coventry, Summit County, Ohio; NARA M432, roll 732, page 87b)
Ancestry.com, 1860 United States Federal Census (Richland, DeKalb County, Indiana; NARA M653, roll 254, page 242)
Ancestry.com, 1870 United States Federal Census (Northwest, Williams County, Ohio; NARA M593, roll 1282, page 145A)
Ancestry.com, public member tree "A miscellaneous research tree" (tree 62391298)
Ancestry.com, Ohio, U.S., Wills and Probate Records (Williams County will records, vol. 5–6, 1889–1897): will of Henry Simons
Ancestry.com, Indiana, U.S., Death Certificates, 1899–2017 (George Simons, 1933)
notes: Child of Henry and Mary Simons; brother or sister of Aaron Simons. Born in Ohio; aged 2 in 1850, 12 in 1860 and 22 in 1870, when he lived with his parents with Sarah J. Simons (17) and Anna B. (2 months), probably his wife and daughter.

Born 25 Jan 1848 (Indiana death certificate, which gives Indiana; the 1850 and 1860 censuses give Ohio); died 26 Apr 1933 in Steuben County, Indiana, a widower, aged 85. The certificate names his father Henry Simons and his wife Sophronia; an Indiana marriage record names her Sophronia McClain.

A farmer in North West Township, Williams County, Ohio, in 1880 and at Clear Lake, Steuben County, Indiana, by 1900 (owning a mortgaged farm), with his wife Sophronia ("Sarah") and their daughters Anna B., Alvaretta, Merta M. and Hallie.
